title: Pricing Page Components
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

As a potential customer, I want to be able to compare different subscription plans and features so that I can make a good decision.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:gorilla:</custom> Goal

To make pricing as transparent and easy to understand as possible in order to convince more customers.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-2">:brain:</custom> Assumptions

* Well-structured information on the plans helps users to decide on a plan
* A well-designed price comparison helps to sell users an annual subscription
* Transparent information on pricing and feature scope has a positive influence on customers' purchasing decisions

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-4">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

### Pricing Cards Grid

* As a potential customer I want to see pricing plans displayed in a clear card layout So that I can easily compare different subscription tiers
* Acceptance Criteria:

    * Display at least 3 pricing tiers (Basic, Premium, Enterprise)
    * Show price, billing period, and key features for each plan
    * Integrate variant switch between monthly and annually payment
    
        * display strikethrough prices
        
    * Include CTA button for each plan
    * Grid is a swipe slider on mobile

### Payment Switch (Monthly/Annually)

* As a potential customer I want to toggle between monthly and annual pricing So that I can choose my preferred billing cycle and see potential savings
* Acceptance Criteria:

    * Toggle switch between monthly and annual pricing
    * Show percentage/amount saved with annual billing
    * Update all pricing cards simultaneously when switching
    * Maintain selected billing preference during session

### Feature Comparison Table

* As a potential customer I want to see a detailed feature comparison across all plans So that I can make an informed decision about which plan best suits my needs
* Acceptance Criteria:

    * List all features categorized by functionality
    * Use clear indicators (checkmarks, x-marks) for feature availability
    * Include descriptions for features
    * Possibility to add links / text links
    * Ensure mobile-responsive design for table layout
    * Highlight feature differences between plans / make it possible to show only differences
    * Make the table header sticky, so that the user always knows which plan the features belong to
    
        * Add a CTA to the header cells, for easy subscription
